{{Show badges |Navbar-GOGPT-tracker|Navbar-Global_Coal_Plant_Tracker}}
'''Tapada do Outeiro power station''' is an operating power station of at least 990-megawatts (MW) in Medas, Porto, Portugal with multiple units, some of which are not currently operating.
